population: Fixed model-generated atomic module pairs that pass condition-blind isolated contract qualification
within_family_aggregation_order: compute each program condition over all 16 fixed scheduler seeds without deduplicating or reweighting
average two fixed repeats within model
average two model blocks within family
required_denominators: normalized causal-order trace types as unweighted coverage sensitivity

exposure_identifiability_gate.failure_interpretation: Exposure/censoring changed; direct-P risk difference and equivalence are not identifiable. Report completion, exposure, full-seed V incidence, and V given exposure separately.

model_missingness.aggregation: repeat mean within model, then equal model mean within family
model_missingness.confirmatory_population: families with at least one isolated-qualified repeat from both frozen models
model_missingness.forbidden: letting a model with two eligible repeats receive twice the weight of a model with one eligible repeat

uncertainty: family-cluster bootstrap stratified by the four fixed mechanisms; frozen resample seed and replicate count before external calls
robustness: machine endpoint versus blinded human endpoint direction
fixed-seed primary estimate versus normalized causal-order trace-type coverage
positive_claim_gate: both model blocks agree in direction
at least three of four mechanisms agree and the fourth is not significantly opposite
blinded human program-level any-V endpoint does not contradict the machine program-level any-V corroboration endpoint
equivalence_claim: For conservative planning, the 96.667% TOST interval (one-sided alpha 0.05/3) is wholly inside the equivalence margin; final Holm step-down decisions use the ordered p-values
inconclusive_rule: Intervals spanning both zero and either equivalence boundary are reported as imprecise or heterogeneous, never as no effect
stopping_rule: Stop at the fixed 96 generation slots and maximum 384 composed programs regardless of sign or significance
forbidden: counting seeds, programs, models, repeats, or reviewers as independent families
calling benchmark-development exposure model-training seen versus unseen
calling an abstract lock, identity, version, observation, or structure error a direct physical-temporal P violation
treating NE as C or as evidence of lower risk
using raw timestamp differences to define or scientifically weight distinct traces
calling the controlled LONG factor an LLM token-distance or code-authoring effect
